description: This file defines API endpoints related to emoji management and interactions in a sports live-streaming backend. It includes endpoints for listing emojis, submitting emoji reactions, and retrieving reaction summaries for events. It interfaces with a database using SQLAlchemy ORM models and employs FastAPI for web framework functionalities.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of active emojis.

methods.description: Handles POST requests to record a user's emoji reaction to an event or match and broadcasts the updated reaction counts.
